name: Budle Hall Camping
accommodation: Two large tent pitches for up to 6 people each, plus a Secret Garden pitch for one group
suitableFor: Small groups and families who want a quiet, simple camp
dogs: One or two dogs under control welcome on Pitches 1 and 2
beachAccess: A short walk to the beach
confirmedFeatures: Private hot shower and toilet per pitch, outdoor cold shower for sand, cold-water sinks, firepit allowed, wheelbarrows
overview: An exclusive camping field at Budle Hall just outside Bamburgh, with sea views and only a handful of pitches. The two main pitches each have a private hot shower and toilet, and there is an outdoor cold shower for rinsing off sand. Small campervans fit through the gate, and the beach is a short walk away.
surfTripFit: An outdoor shower for sandy kit and a short walk to the beach suit surfers who like to camp.
